fusions.name: Swarm-Stuffed Sack
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh sack stuffed with conjured locusts that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage; 25% of the damage comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Swarm Closes In
fusions.desc: Your mesh fills with a devouring swarm around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plague Let Out
fusions.desc: Opens your mesh and lets out a cloud of conjured locusts for 10 seconds; it swarms enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Gorging Season
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, the swarm caught in your mesh gorges on it: for 4 seconds you heal for 20% of the damage you deal. Once every 15 seconds.
